linear_model_assessment.conclusion: Linear model is a valid first-order approximation in a limited regime, but nonlinear/saturation response and calibration are likely required for accurate multi-level operation.
linear_model_assessment.recommendation: Characterize dn_eff vs control/state experimentally; use calibrated inverse mapping or nonlinear model in decoder if response is not linear.

temperature_assessment.conclusion: Temperature must be considered: thermo-optic drift can consume phase margin, and thermal back-reaction (retention) is strongly temperature-dependent.

thermo_optic_model.note: Order-of-magnitude; real dn/dT depends on material/stack.

temperature_assessment.recommendation: Include thermal management/stabilization and temperature-aware calibration; measure dn/dT, Ea and kinetics per material.
